name: Dr. Shiva Kumar
bio: Dr. Shiva Kumar is a highly experienced and respected surgeon with over 25 years of expertise in general and colorectal surgery. He completed his MBBS from Bangalore Medical College in 2001, followed by an MPH from the University of Illinois, USA, in 2005. He earned his DNB in General Surgery in 2012 and holds multiple prestigious fellowships, including FIAGES (Fellowship of the Indian Association of Gastro-Intestinal Endo Surgeons), FACRSI (Fellowship of the Association of Colon & Rectal Surgeons of India), FMAS (Fellowship in Minimal Access Surgery), and FALS (Fellowship of Advanced Laparoscopic Surgery, 2015–2016). Dr. Shiva Kumar specializes in advanced laparoscopic and minimally invasive surgical techniques, providing effective, low-discomfort solutions for a wide range of conditions. Known for his compassionate, patient-centered care and meticulous surgical skills, he is an active participant in national and international medical conferences and workshops. He is also a proud member of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI) and the Karnataka Medical Council.
